Vehicle Graphics.

Transform your vehicle into a moving advertisement with professional vehicle graphics in Norwich, Norfolk. Our eye-catching graphics will help you stand out.

Get a free quoteCall 01603 407786

Vehicle graphics range from a phone number on a door to a full colour-change wrap, and the right choice depends on what the vehicle needs to say, how long you will keep it and your budget.

Broadland Digital have been at the forefront of van and business graphics for many years. Offering cut vinyl, printed graphics & vehicle graphics for well over a decade and with the management team having accrued over 30 years personal experience in this sector, you are sure you will be getting the right advice. With vehicle graphics being one of the relative lowest cost forms of marketing, we still believe it to be the best bang for your buck forms of marketing available. Everywhere you drive, park or even just stopping for fuel, we can help you to get your vehicle & business noticed!

Able to offer simple logo and phone number vinyl’s such as what you would expect on a taxi, or a full colour change wrap on a 56-seater coach, we’ve got you covered. Having recently installed the latest 8 colour, 1440dpi printers, the quality and colour vibrance puts us head of the competition. With these machines able to print approximately 1.5m wide by 50m in length, printing graphics for even the largest of vehicles isn’t much of a challenge for our equipment and team.

We can also offer Chapter 8 reflective kits for the majority of mainstream vehicles or can produce bespoke cut reflectives using our in-house drag-knife and laser cutters. If you are not local to the office, we have the latest databases of vehicle outlines available so can even offer the kits for post if you prefer to install the vehicle graphics yourself.

Using only the best materials from 3M and Metamark, you can rest assured your graphics will last for years.

Choosing vehicle graphics: three decisions to make first

Van wrapping in Norwich, or lettering?

Van wrapping Norwich firms choose makes sense when the van is the shopfront, when the paint colour is not what you want, or when a fleet has mixed colours to unify. For most trades, cut lettering on the existing paint does the job for far less. Our wrap versus part graphics comparison walks through repairs, removal and budget for each option.

Wrap versus part graphics comparison

Chapter 8 reflective kits for road workers

If your vehicles stop on or beside the highway, a client may ask for rear chevrons. We supply Chapter 8 reflective kits for most mainstream vehicles and can cut bespoke reflective shapes on our drag-knife and laser cutters for anything unusual. Kits can be posted if you prefer to fit them, but check with your client exactly what they require before ordering.

Cut vinyl lettering: the cost-effective start

Cut vinyl lettering puts your company name, phone number and web address onto the paint in one or two colours. It is quick to produce, easy to update when a detail changes and leaves the least film to remove when the van is sold or returned. For leased vans in particular it is often the sensible starting point, with a printed logo added later if needed.

Tell us about the vehicle, what you want it to do for the business and where you are based, and we will recommend vehicle graphics to suit. Get a quote.

How it works.

  1. Tell us about the vehicle

    Send the make, model and year (or registration), a few photos of each side and what you want on it: logo, phone number, web address, services.

  2. Design and proof

    Our in-house designers lay the graphics out on an outline of your exact vehicle and send a proof. Nothing is printed until you approve it.

  3. Print and cut

    Graphics are printed on our 8-colour, 1440dpi printers or cut from coloured vinyl in-house, using 3M and Metamark materials.

  4. Fit

    Bring the vehicle to our Norwich workshop or, within 30 miles, we can fit at your premises. Courtesy vehicles are available while a van is off the road.

Vehicle graphics we've produced.

Questions.

How much do vehicle graphics cost?

Supply-and-fit van graphics start from £149 + VAT for basic cut vinyl lettering, £210 + VAT for standard graphics and £455 + VAT for our pro package. Wraps and larger vehicles are quoted individually; send us photos and the make and model for a price.

How long do vehicle graphics last?

We use 3M and Metamark materials. Looked after correctly, van graphics will last up to 7 years.

Can graphics be removed later?

Yes. Vinyl graphics are semi-permanent, so they can be removed or replaced, for example when you change vehicle or update your details.

Do you fit graphics on site?

You can bring the vehicle to our Norwich workshop, or we can fit at your premises within 30 miles. Further afield, ask us for a quote or a posted kit.

Can you design the graphics for us?

Yes. Our in-house design team can design your vehicle graphics from scratch or work with your existing logo, brand guidelines or design agency.
